features: A real studio photo in the first screen, with a flash sheet pinned over it that inks itself as the page opens
Nine flash sheets that draw themselves from purple stencil to black ink as they scroll into view, filtered by artist
Two healed pieces with their real stencils laid back over them: drag across to compare
A consultation form laid out like the studio's own paperwork, placement picked on a body outline
The next free chair and the guest artist's dates worked out from today's date
name: Marrow & Pin
short: A tattoo studio whose flash wall inks itself, stencil to black, as you scroll.
long: A private studio site in black and bone with one pink for booking. The first screen is a real photo of a stencil going on skin, with a flash sheet pinned over it that inks itself as the page opens. Nine more sheets on the wall draw themselves from purple stencil to black as they come into view, two healed pieces have their real stencils laid back over them to drag across, and any sheet carries straight into a consultation form with the placement picked on a body outline.
proves: Your own drawings can be the website, and they can still take the booking.
story: Built for the trades that sell by showing the work: the drawings are the design, so the page had to be made of them rather than of photographs of them.
